minutes.summary: The Lunenburg Municipal Building Design Committee spent most of the meeting questioning Town Manager Jen Warren about space needs for a consolidated town administration building, covering land-use department co-location, vault and storage needs, private meeting space, ADA/security requirements, and floor layout. Tony then updated the group on the master plan's prioritized capital project list, naming Ritter/Town Hall and Turkey Hill as top priorities and raising the possibility of combining Turkey Hill, the track, and the primary school playground into one schools project; the committee scheduled building walkthroughs for October 28 and 30 and its next meeting for November 3, and voted to adjourn.

what_happened.line: Committee named Town Hall/Ritter and Turkey Hill its top capital priorities and floated folding Turkey Hill, the track, and the primary school playground into one combined schools project.
Most of the meeting was the town manager fielding questions on space needs for a single consolidated town administration building, covering storage, private meeting rooms, and department layout.

A member raised whether the town's debt capacity allows pursuing the schools project and the town administration building at the same time; an earlier estimate suggested it could, depending on timing and rates.
Committee agreed to walk through the Town Hall and Ritter buildings in person on October 28 and 30 before drafting questions for department staff.
Members flagged that an earlier Taylor and Burns building design may have included feature creep beyond baseline needs and agreed to review it together at a future meeting.

why_it_matters: These capital priorities feed the town's 10-year list that eventually goes to voters for debt-funded building projects.
Combining Turkey Hill, the track, and the playground into one project could change how and when that work reaches a town meeting warrant.
Whether the town can afford the schools project and a new administration building at once will shape which capital asks appear on ballots and when.
